note: This artifact proves a live inference call and preserves its candidate for comparison. It is never feature authority and never establishes coverage.

narrative.iNeed: to project Content Security Policy headers, classify loopback binding requests, and dispatch allowed HTTP routes
narrative.soThat: the query console operates securely within defined network and routing boundaries

scenarios.title: Project Content Security Policy Header
given: a request for the query console security header policies
then: the canonical Content Security Policy header value is returned
scenarios.observableResult: The returned string contains the full CSP directive set including script-src and style-src constraints
scenarios.conformanceSignal: projectsCspPolicy returns the expected cspPolicy string from query-console-csp-policy contract

scenarios.title: Classify Loopback Bind Request
given: a loopback bind request with a candidate hostname
when: classifiesLoopbackBind is called with the request object
then: the hostname is evaluated against admission criteria and a classification result is produced
scenarios.observableResult: The loopback bind execution result indicates whether the hostname is admitted
scenarios.conformanceSignal: classifiesLoopbackBind evaluates hostname admission status via loopback-bind authority

scenarios.title: Classify Route Dispatch Request
given: an incoming HTTP route request with a pathname and method
then: the request is classified to a target route identifier
scenarios.observableResult: The route dispatch classification returns a routeId matching designated endpoints
scenarios.conformanceSignal: classifiesRoute produces a route-dispatch-result containing the mapped routeId

obligations.statement: Must project the query console Content Security Policy string using the execution authority.
Must classify loopback bind requests against admitted hostnames using semantic authority rules.
Must classify HTTP pathname and method requests into valid route identifiers.

queryEvidence.commandText: SELECT bm.mechanic AS mechanic, bm.modulePath AS modulePath, sym.name AS symbolName, sr.startLine AS startLine, sr.endLine AS endLine FROM bodyMechanics bm JOIN sourceReferences sr ON bm.sourceReferenceId = sr.referenceId LEFT JOIN symbols sym ON bm.fromSymbolId = sym.symbolId WHERE bm.mechanic = 'object-construction' ORDER BY bm.modulePath, sr.startLine

modelAssessment.rationale: The bounded source-fact cluster and semantic authority contracts define three distinct boundary policy behaviors: projecting CSP headers, classifying loopback bind hostnames, and dispatching routes. Each scenario maps to a single primary obligation backed by a dedicated source file and adapter symbol.
